## Mawaqit 1.1.2-beta.1

A focused beta of the Home screen and Android home-screen widget ahead of the next stable pass.

### Changed

- Refreshed the Home countdown: the prayer name, countdown and time detail now stack cleanly at 200% text while keeping the normal single-line hero on standard text sizes.
- Redesigned the 2×2 widget around the two facts that matter at a glance — the next prayer and its countdown — leaving more room at large system text.
- The 4×2 widget now puts the absolute prayer time beside the countdown, keeps the five-prayer day strip, and shares its last row with a short localized Times hint.
- Widget settings now explains where the optional Hijri date and Times hint appear instead of repeating the switch labels.

### Notes

- Still a beta: the stable channel is unchanged until the recorded on-device smoke pass is complete.
- OTA updates remain opt-in per channel and verify the APK SHA-256 before install.
